en: Did you know? When the radio plays a lullaby, the wild Pokémon in the grass doze off. You'll hardly meet any.
What could Team Rocket want with a radio station? I don't understand it at all...
Sorry, the upper floors are staff only. They never used to be so strict... Something's not right with the Director lately.
Go wherever you like. The Director's his old cheerful self again, so everything's back to normal.
